description: This file defines interfaces and classes for configuring named services within an Orleans hosting environment. It includes the INamedServiceConfigurator interface, the NamedServiceConfigurator class, and extension methods for configuring options and components for services identified by name.

classes.description: A class implementing INamedServiceConfigurator for configuring named services with a name and delegate.
